Do not requeue failed work until root cause, validation, rollback, and deduplication evidence are documented.

No new proposals, experiments, change requests, telemetry, spend, dependencies, permissions, schedules, deployments, or launch activity are queue-eligible this cycle. Requeue only after documented deduplication, root cause, isolated validation, rollback, ownership, and queue eligibility.

Continue existing measurement with available telemetry only. Preserve unknown revenue, attribution, ROI, margin, cost-to-learn, causal lift, infrastructure cost, labor cost, incremental cost, and operational health. Do not treat missing data as zero or request duplicate telemetry.

Maintain bounded read-only security evidence capture and keep the private launch gate unchanged. Missing fleet-doctor, operations, isolation, release-control, monitoring, and incident evidence remains unknown rather than passed. No credentials, permissions, configuration changes, deployment, external outreach, or spending are authorized by this pass.

Keep the existing gated-product legal readiness work active. Internal preparation may continue, but sending the prepared permission request remains an owner decision and is not authorized by this pass. No public exposure, monetization, alert expansion, configuration change, or deployment is approved.

Continue failed-run containment only. Review retained artifacts and document root cause, smallest isolated repair, focused validation, rollback, ownership, deduplication, and explicit requeue-or-close disposition before any requeue. Technical metrics must not be presented as financial benefit.
